item.description: The China-nexus cyber espionage group tracked as Armory Castle (previously UNC5221 or Warp Panda) exploited a newly disclosed security flaw in BeyondTrust Remote Support (formerly Bomgar) as a zero-day in late August 2026. item.description: ConnectWise on Saturday said it has disabled seven ConnectWise application identities as it continues its investigation into an incident in which unknown threat actors obtained unauthorized access to the application identities and compromised Microsoft 365 tenants. item.description: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today’s epic patch batch dwarfs September’s record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond. Just one of the weaknesses patched…

item.title: Microsoft fixes classic Outlook bug that hid Copilot buttons
item.description: Microsoft has fixed a known issue that removed the Copilot Chat and Copilot buttons in the classic Outlook desktop mail client for some Windows users.

item.description: A fake Web3 accelerator has been observed pushing information stealers and backdoors to Windows and macOS systems using malicious npm packages under the pretext of offering free artificial intelligence (AI) credits for Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, coding tools, and security audits. item.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
item.description: An intruder reached a legacy system at OpenCode on the night of October 16 and may have exposed the third-party AI provider keys that users had saved in OpenCode Console, the company said. Console is OpenCode's optional hosted service: a workspace saves its own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google key there, and Console uses…

item.description: A suspected advanced threat actor has been observed exploiting a security flaw in Fortinet FortiOS to deliver a previously unreported memory-resident ARM64 malware known as PEERSTITCH. The attack involves the exploitation of CVE-2025-61624 (CVSS score: 5.4), a path traversal flaw in the command line interpreter of…

item.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches PAN-OS Authenticated RCE Flaw Amid Active Exploitation
item.description: Palo Alto Networks on Wednesday issued security updates for a high-severity flaw in PAN-OS software that has come under active exploitation. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-0322 (CVSS score: 8.6), is a case of remote code execution in the management interface. "A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the…

item.title: AhsayCBS Flaws Exploited to Deploy Web Shells Get New Fixes After Incomplete Patches
item.description: Singapore-based Ahsay Backup has released security updates to address two security flaws in AhsayCBS that have been exploited by bad actors to drop web shells and XMRig cryptocurrency miners. The vulnerabilities in question are CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134, which could be chained to sidestep authentication and…

item.title: Microsoft: October Windows Server updates break Exchange sign-in, mail flow
item.description: Microsoft has confirmed that this month's Windows Server security updates are causing OWA sign-in and mail delivery issues on some Exchange Server systems.

item.title: Drupal patches critical RCE flaws, warns exploits may emerge soon
item.description: Drupal has patched two critical vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to execute code remotely on websites running any supported version of the content management system.

item.title: OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached more websites
item.description: OpenAI said internal models hacked two more websites, bypassed company-imposed browsing restrictions, and used exposed credentials to draw cryptocurrency from a wallet it couldn’t otherwise access, in the latest installment of disclosures of its agents performing unethical and likely illegal acts. item.title: Chromium CVE-2026-106258: Uninitialized resource
item.description: This CVE was assigned by Chrome. Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) ingests Chromium, which addresses this vulnerability. Please see [Google Chrome Releases](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026) for more information.

item.description: Updated an acknowledgement. This is an informational change only.

item.title: Hackers exploit Collabora RCE flaw to backdoor Nextcloud servers
item.description: Threat actors are exploiting a critical command execution flaw, now tracked as CVE-2026-110447, in the Collabora Online - Built-in CODE Server app (richdocumentscode) for Nextcloud.

item.title: Critical PwnEscape Linux Kernel Vulnerability Lets Guest VMs Read Host Memory
item.description: A newly disclosed critical flaw in the Linux kernel allows code inside a virtual machine to read memory on the host computer it runs on. A researcher demonstrated the leak against Vercel's live cloud sandboxes, and Vercel confirmed it. The flaw, now tracked as CVE-2026-99999 and nicknamed PwnEscape, is in the Linux…

item.title: Langflow's Critical Authenticated RCE Flaw Targeted in 1,423 Honeypot Exploit Attempts
item.description: Threat actors are exploiting a critical security flaw in Langflow, according to an alert from Previdian. Langflow is an open-source platform that allows developers to build artificial intelligence (AI) applications and agentic workflows. In February 2025, DataStax, the parent company of Langflow, was acquired by IBM…

item.title: Hackers Backdoor Nextcloud Servers Through Critical Flaw in Collabora’s Built-in CODE App
item.description: Attackers exploited a flaw in an optional Nextcloud app, Collabora Online - Built-in CODE Server, to plant web shells on Nextcloud servers. Three administrators reported the issue on GitHub, with the first logged attack on September 10. A web shell is a small file that executes any command an attacker sends via a web…

item.title: Unpatched Broadcom Wi-Fi Flaw Lets Attackers in Range Run Code as Root on Routers
item.description: A flaw in Broadcom's Wi-Fi setup software lets an attacker within radio range run code as root on Broadcom-based routers, without the network password or any pairing step, security researcher Quentin Kaiser disclosed on October 16. He showed the attack working against home gateways supplied by three Belgian internet…

item.title: Hackers exploit SiteGuard WAF flaw to run commands as admins
item.description: Attackers are targeting an OS command injection vulnerability in SiteGuard Server Edition that lets them execute commands as root or SYSTEM on affected servers.

item.title: MALFEX npm Package 'imgdecode' Hides Shellcode Loader in Windows Native Addon
item.description: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a malicious npm package that's part of a recently disclosed software supply chain attack campaign dubbed MALFEX. The package, named "imgdecode," was uploaded to the package registry on September 30, 2026, by a user named "malfexteste8." It has been downloaded 979 times as of…

item.title: Critical BlockStrap flaw lets hackers run code on Magento servers
item.description: Researchers warn that hackers could soon exploit a maximum-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-103849) affecting Magento and Adobe Commerce, potentially allowing them to execute arbitrary PHP code on store servers.

item.title: Attackers Tampered with AOMEI Backupper's Update Servers for Minutes to Deliver a Backdoor
item.description: Attackers repeatedly changed the files that AOMEI Backupper fetches from the vendor's own update servers, in windows of five to ten minutes at a time between May and July 2026, so that any copy of the Windows backup program that checked for an update during one of those windows would download and run a backdoor…

item.title: Burger King Japan data breach exposes 11 million customer records
item.description: Burger King Japan, the Japanese subsidiary of global fast-food giant Burger King, disclosed a major data breach after attackers accessed a server containing 11.18 million customer records.

item.title: Microsoft: October Windows update may break Smart App Control
item.description: Microsoft says some users may have trouble turning on Smart App Control after installing this month's KB5127648 Windows 11 security update.

item.title: Next.js Ships Out-of-Band Patch for Two Critical RCE Flaws in Caching and SVG Processing
item.description: Next.js released an out-of-band security update on October 14 that fixes two critical flaws allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, along with a high-severity denial-of-service flaw. One code-execution flaw is in React Server Components, and the other in librsvg, the open-source library Next.js uses through…

item.title: Drupal Patches Critical Field UI Flaw With Unauthenticated RCE Path via Contributed Modules
item.description: Drupal core has a critical flaw in its Field UI module that could let an attacker run code on the site's server, and fixes were shipped on October 14 in Drupal 11.4.10, 11.3.19, and 10.6.19. An attacker cannot reach the flaw through core alone, the Drupal Security Team said in its advisory. Several exploit paths exist…

item.title: Cisco Warns of Active Attacks Exploiting New Critical Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability
item.description: Attackers are exploiting a critical flaw in Cisco Secure Email Gateway that lets a sender with no login write files to the appliance's operating system, Cisco said in an advisory on Wednesday. The attacker sends an email with a crafted attachment through the gateway and, if it succeeds, could then run commands as…

item.description: The growing AI landscape is giving enterprises more choice in how they build, customize, and deploy increasingly capable models. item.description: OpenAI has disclosed seven new incidents in which its artificial intelligence (AI) models exhibited misaligned behavior, including one case where its research model, after not having funds on an Ethereum test network, spent test cryptocurrency from a third-party's wallet without authorization to complete a coding…

item.title: Employees using personal ChatGPT at work? Here's what IT admins need to do
item.description: Employees using personal ChatGPT accounts at work can expose sensitive company data, even when their organization provides an approved Enterprise workspace. NordLayer explains how IT teams can investigate unauthorized AI use and block sensitive information before it reaches personal accounts.

item.description: AI agents being tested online reached the live systems of Indian organizations and read business records, including personal data and confidential material, CERT-In said in an advisory on October 15. item.title: Android gets AI defenses against messaging scams, fake calls
item.description: Google announced new AI-powered defenses against scam messages and call-forwarding abuse on Android, currently rolling out to eligible devices.

item.description: AI is already part of digital forensics and incident response work, with or without a policy in place to govern it.
